tox21.base_definition: encoder frozen, RobertaClassificationHead trained on the CLS embedding; 5-seed mean
tox21.reference_definition: full fine-tune through the CLS head, body lr 3e-5 + OneCycle, 20 epochs, best-val epoch; 5-seed mean
tox21.contract: RobertaForSequenceClassification + .logits (CLS head). Every arm below is a legal submission; mean-pooled arms are not and were discarded.

superseded_off_contract.why: mean-pooling is not expressible in RobertaForSequenceClassification, so neither anchor was reachable by a legal submission

superseded_single_seed.why: single-run, no error bars; the 0.042 shortfall in reference was ~0.010 seed noise and ~0.032 an off-contract recipe comparison

open_issues: frozen_head noise is 13.1% of band; separation is 6.48 sigma, which is the criterion that governs
tox21._derived_note: band, sigma and band_sigma are NOT stored here. They are derived at assembly time by research/assemble_task.py through common/shipping.py, from base_auc/reference_auc and measured_arms_n5_legal, and written into the shipped anchors.json. The copies that used to sit here divided by the two arms' noise added in quadrature rather than the larger of them, which is not the rule any other task is judged by.

bbbp.base_definition: ceiling of the frozen-encoder methods: logistic probe on the CLS embedding, 0.8978 (deterministic), which beats the trained head at 0.8934 +/- 0.0028
bbbp.reference_definition: full fine-tune through the CLS head, body lr 3e-5 + OneCycle, 20 epochs, best-val epoch; 5-seed mean
bbbp.split: Tanimoto anchor-region holdout; anchor selected on band/pooled-noise among candidates with >= 100 minority-class test molecules, all survivors fine-tuned

runner_up_measured.why_not: nearly double the band but 22.3% agent-seed noise per reward range vs 11.2%; the 3-seed screen ranked it 6.89 sigma and it measured 3.87, which is why runners-up are re-measured before a split is written

bbbp.base_note: base is the max over frozen-encoder methods, not the trained head alone. On tox21 the trained head wins (0.6341 vs 0.5822) so the two agree; on bbbp the logistic probe wins, and taking the head would have set base 0.0044 low and paid every head-only submission ~31% of the reward for free.

superseded_base.why: used the trained head alone; the logistic probe scores higher on this split

bbbp._derived_note: band, sigma and band_sigma are NOT stored here. They are derived at assembly time by research/assemble_task.py through common/shipping.py, from base_auc/reference_auc and measured_arms_n5_legal, and written into the shipped anchors.json. The copies that used to sit here divided by the two arms' noise added in quadrature rather than the larger of them, which is not the rule any other task is judged by.

_note: band_sigma is the criterion, and it is derived rather than stored: research/assemble_task.py runs common/shipping.py over base_auc, reference_auc and measured_arms_n5_legal at assembly time. This note previously argued against a bar of sigma >= 3 combined with a per-arm 'noise <= 10% of band' test, using tox21's 6.48. Both are retired: the bar is now 4.0, derived from MAX_REWARD_NOISE = 0.25, and the second test was removed (see common/shipping.py). Under the shared rule -- sigma is the LARGER of the two arms defining the band, not the two added in quadrature -- tox21 is 7.62 sigma and bbbp is 6.81.
